gen-press-start-2p-fs-plein: Plein is a plain sans with clear channels into its round letters. Press Start 2P excels at height and a gentle ebb and flow of weight; Plein, moderate in height, hardly varies at all.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-roundo: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with mild stroke variation. And Roundo, bent from one length of tubing, glides through paragraph after paragraph with every small counter left clear.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-spline-sans: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart like cut-outs, with big open-looking bowls and a comfortable level of stroke contrast. Spline Sans then keeps every stroke uniform, with wide gaps at the curves.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-synonym: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart, like cut-outs. Its horizontals run slightly slimmer than its verticals, while Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink with generous curve openings.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-aclonica: Fun and retro up top, Press Start 2P gives way to Aclonica, a sans with a deep midsection and a stretched-out line. Widely spaced letters make for a slow, unhurried read.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-allerta: Wide, loose tracking lets this sans read openly, its x-height prominent. Allerta moves along at a leisurely pace, while Press Start 2P adds a quiet variation in line weight within each letter.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Contemporary and compact, Alumni Sans SC is a plain sans. Press Start 2P is best at spacing out big, open-looking bowls, while Alumni Sans SC is best at squeezed, oversized lowercase.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-anaheim: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart, with stems that outweigh its hairlines just a little. Anaheim packs rounded forms densely, so the eye glides down a paragraph.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-arsenal: Press Start 2P pins big, open-looking lowercase bowls far apart, like cut-out letters, with only light modulation. Arsenal, a plain sans, wins with a close-knit string of letters, where gaps barely register.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-arsenal-sc: Fun, retro, and spaced like cut-outs: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart. Arsenal SC, a sans-serif with a faint thick-thin shift and tight fit, keeps things tidy underneath.
